column1: # "Single source of truth" means ONE OWNER PER FACT, not one file: the canonical definition is
# a set of format-fit files, and each fact kind below names its OWNING file (the one place the
# fact is stated), the legal DERIVED MIRRORS of that fact elsewhere in the corpus (files that
# restate it), and the doctrine that governs each owner→mirror pair (refuses the day the two
# drift). A fact stated in two files with no named governor is the duplication this registry
# exists to refuse — the FACT-OWNERSHIP doctrine verifies the registry holds and is complete
# against the corpus's actual restatement pairs.

column2: owner (exactly one; the fact is stated here)
